business_summary: SOFT99corporation manufactures and sells chemical products for auto and home care in China, Taiwan, Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Vietnam, South Korea, Sri Lanka, Brunei, Myanmar, Russia, Ukraine, Germany, Poland, the United Kingdom, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, the United States, Brazil, Paraguay, Australia, and internationally. The company offers body wax and polish, cleaners, shampoo, car wash equipment and supplies, synthetic snow tire chains, and air fresheners; and wax coatings, glass water repellants, anti-fog products, and in-car care supplies. It also provides body and touch-up pens; brush and spray type car repair paints; car repair tools, such as putties, compounds, sandpaper products, adhesives and tapes, rust removing and muffler products, rubber and unpainted plastic parts restoration agents, radiator stop-leak, belt sprays, blade revivers, cleaners, and degreasing agents and other products; and car maintenance and accessories products, including wiper rubbers and blades, TPMS, maintenance chemicals, radiators, oil related products for engine bay, fragrances and deodorants, seat cushions and covers, handle covers, cushions, and other products. In addition, the company offers household products for cleaning, repairing, coating, and removing rust from kitchen, interiors, electronics, windows, bathrooms, leather, and other products; cleaning and anti-fog measures for eyeglasses; and rain repellent, antifog, and other convenient products for sports products under Sports Plus brand. Further, it provides automobile maintenance; body repair and painting; driving lessons; automobile leasing and rental; real estate leasing; service incubation; and nursing care support services. SOFT99corporation was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
